انخرطت (form VII)

# اِنْخَرَطْتَ (inḵaraṭta) /in.xa.ratˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْخَرَطَ (inḵaraṭa)
# اِنْخَرَطْتِ (inḵaraṭti) /in.xa.ratˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْخَرَطَ (inḵaraṭa)
# اِنْخَرَطَتْ (inḵaraṭat) /in.xa.ra.tˤat/: third-pe
